summary: Iteration 3 tested Knowledge base + Telegram creator features (backend + frontend). All 10 backend pytest tests passed (100%) and full frontend flow passed. Verified: GET /api/knowledge and /api/telegram/status return correct data for creator (bot_configured=true, bot_username=AI_Buxgalter_yordamchisi_bot); admin (non-creator) gets 403 on both; POST /api/knowledge/upload of a .txt file returns status=ready with rules_count>0 (~6 rules extracted via Claude); GET /api/knowledge/{id} returns rules array; the extracted rules appear in /api/rules with structured_rule.knowledge_doc_id linking back; DELETE /api/knowledge/{id} removes doc + associated rules. AI chat with 'Bundan keyin Yandex cheklarini 1C da Sotuv hujjati sifatida yoz' triggered save_creator_rule (verified in tool_trace and rule persisted). search_knowledge best-effort not always invoked by the LLM but code path exists (no assertion failure). Frontend: creator sees 'Bilim bazasi' nav (nav-creator-knowledge) -> /creator/bilim renders knowledge-page with telegram-card + telegram-bot-link pointing to https://t.me/AI_Buxgalter_yordamchisi_bot and upload-card; file upload via knowledge-file-input showed toast, knowledge-row appeared, opening it displayed knowledge-detail-dialog with rules, and delete removed the row. Newly-registered administrator does NOT see Bilim bazasi nav and direct navigation to /creator/bilim redirects to /.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby — console warning; a11y minor

action_items: (Minor a11y) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to knowledge-detail-dialog to silence Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: services/knowledge.py analyze_with_ai always uses AI_MODEL_PROVIDER/NAME from env; ensure claude-sonnet-4-6 (typo?) is intentional — usually claude-sonnet-4.5/4-5. Not blocking since Emergent LLM key routes it correctly.
routes.py delete_knowledge swallows all exceptions to 404 — could mask real infra errors; log the exception.

Knowledge upload has 20MB size cap but no MIME/extension whitelist server-side; the extract_text falls back gracefully but consider explicit deny for unsupported ext to avoid ambiguous 'failed' status.
search_knowledge does simple $regex on unindexed fields — fine for now but add text index if collection grows.
api/routes.py is now >550 lines with knowledge/telegram appended; consider splitting into per-domain routers.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_ admin user via /api/auth/register and 2 knowledge_docs (test_kb_1c.txt, test_kb_search.txt) which were deleted at end of tests. One additional frontend-uploaded doc was also uploaded and deleted through UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Telegram polling (long-polling inside backend) cannot be tested via HTTP as noted; only /api/telegram/status endpoint verified. AI-based knowledge ingest averages ~10-15s per file (Claude via emergentintegrations). Regression suite for knowledge at /app/backend/tests/test_knowledge.py can be reused; combine with prior /app/backend/tests/test_retest.py for full backend coverage.
